blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validateGiftCardsNotExpiredStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates that none of the gift cards applied to the cart have
expired. It throws an error for any gift card whose expiration date has
passed, preventing its remaining balance from being debited at checkout.

children.name: giftCards
children.description: The gift cards applied to the cart.

children.name: code
children.description: The unique redemption code for the gift card.

children.name: expires_at
children.description: The date the gift card expires, or null if it does not expire.
